title: Berserker physique: Arms
summary: Part of the Berserker physique series: NH explains why big arms are essential to his envisioned physique. Arms are what people see in a t-shirt, should look big relaxed and flexed, and should be slightly out of proportion to make the trunk look smaller. His goal is 19-inch arms, with biceps deliberately dominant, a love rooted in manga/anime characters.

claims.claim: Big arms are essential to the physique he is building and make any physique look much better.
Arms and forearms are the body parts always exposed in a t-shirt, unlike pecs or shoulders.
Arms should look big both relaxed and flexed; how they look relaxed depends heavily on biceps insertions and genetics (lower insertions look bigger relaxed).
A higher body fat percentage, especially fat on the arms, helps arms look impressive when relaxed and unpumped.
In the Berserker physique, limbs should be slightly out of proportion to make the trunk look smaller, as part of an illusion strategy.
His current goal is 19-inch arms to keep everything proportional for his physique.
His obsession with big biceps comes from the coolest anime and manga characters always having big arms.
Even when he was small, his biceps were always big because he put 100% into biceps training; now he's catching up the triceps but wants the biceps to stay dominant.
